items.text: Yesterday, the analyst team tested MR Studio more thoroughly. They found several bugs during the tests, but they didn't report all of them immediately. Today, they are telling us about the problems they found. Some of the bugs are related to report parameters, and others affect the data displayed on the screen. I have already fixed two of the issues, but there are still a few bugs that I need to investigate. I will fix the remaining bugs as soon as possible. Before we deploy the new version, I want the analysts to test the application again. If they don't find any critical issues, we can continue with the deployment. The important thing is to understand why these bugs were not reported earlier. In future tests, I want the team to report problems as soon as they find them.
